title: Deliciu V2 Grape 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Deliciu V2 Grape Nic Salt is a rich and fruity e-liquid that perfectly captures the deep, juicy sweetness of freshly picked grapes. This bold flavour profile is both smooth and full-bodied, delivering a satisfying vaping experience with each inhale. Ideal for vapers who love sweet, fruity blends, this e-liquid offers a rich and indulgent flavour that’s hard to put down. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The enhanced formulation ensures smoothness and rich flavour with every puff. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nicotine salts provide rapid nicotine relief and a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase e-liquids. The Deliciu V2 range from Vaporesso revamps the original line up of bestselling flavours with a heightened focus on quality and flavour precision, delivering improved profiles based on customer feedback. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of low-powered MTL devices, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts deliver exceptionally authentic flavours and consistent, enjoyable vaping.
